[reference generation] The target video is a 40-second comedy skit. Single scene: ancient bedroom at night. S1 charges to the bedside, yanks S2 up, and interrogates him. After being pulled up, S2 is unfazed; he rolls the scrolls back onto himself while listening to Boss Wang, activating his professional persona. He delivers a fatal remark, then switches to his consultant mode for a cost analysis. S1 has a moment of enlightenment-based emotional outburst; S2 turns to the camera, pitching the service to the entire market. <Subject 3> has no lines throughout; after the interruption, he cowers in the corner of the bed and finally slips away unnoticed, serving as a comedic footnote. Filming Discipline: Extreme close-up framing is strictly prohibited throughout the entire film—no face close-ups, extreme close-ups (ECU), extreme close-ups, or shots isolating the face above the chest line are permitted. S2 is the only character allowed to display the body, with the framing range being: Medium Shot MS (waist-up/knee-up framing) and Medium Close-Up MCU (bottom edge of the frame stops above the chest, including shoulders, neck, and collar), connected by a vertical tilt up to show the complete display of "legs → waist → chest"; S1, S3, and the scene generally maintain restrained framing. [Shot 1] At 00:00.000, "Smashing the Door, Startling the Confidant"——Rhythm: sudden onset, abrupt halt, turning cold. Opening static frame: ELS from outside the door looking into the depths of the bedroom, warm candlelight faintly revealing two overlapping figures on the bed, unrolling a scroll and pointing to discuss matters of state. The environment is completely consistent with <Picture 3>. 35mm lens, natural depth of field, lighting and color follow the reference image. The opening only has ambient bedroom sounds—the crackling of candles, distant guard drums, whispers from the direction of the bed, and the rustling sound of the scroll unrolling. The banbu drum starts off-screen: tap, tap, tap—from slow to fast, like a heart approaching from outside the door. The camera follows the drum beats pushing in from ELS: 00:00.3 The frame first sweeps past the line of a leg draping over the edge of the bed—one leg of <Subject 2> draped outside the bed, not yet pulled in, medium shot framing from above the knees to the top of the head, candlelight outlining the leg’s contour, then the camera rises and pans to above the bed: she is straddling <Subject 3>’s body, her collar half-open, the neckline slightly loose, leaning over to embrace and kiss him, still holding the just-unrolled scroll in her hand. 00:00.6 The door is kicked open with a single forceful strike—the door slams open and hits the wall with a bang. The urgent wind effects suddenly rise, <Subject 1> rushes in with large steps following the rhythmic beats of the gong and drums, charging straight toward the foot of the bed, shoulders tense, fists clenched. The two on the bed freeze at the sound, turning their heads in unison. S1 grabs <Subject 2> by the arm, yanking her entire body up from the bed—she lands barefoot, still clutching the just-rolled scroll, her collar half-open and unbuttoned. <Subject 3> jumps up in surprise, pulling the blanket across himself and shrinking into the shadow at the corner of the bed, leaving only a profile silhouette. 00:01.0 The moment S2 stands firm barefoot: a single strike of the large gong, "CLANG—", a half-beat of paused momentum for the pose— the image freezes: S1 gripping the arm, S2 standing barefoot at the edge of the footstool, clothing partially slipped down. This freeze-frame is a medium shot MS (framing from above the knees to the top of the head): her leg lines, bare feet, unadjusted collar and neckline are all in frame, candlelight outlining the contours, the camera neither pushes in nor crops the face, chaos and composure are seen simultaneously

[
    "d": "On the frozen half-beat, reverse shot of Subject 2 in MCU (frame bottom edge stops above the chest; collar and lapel partially visible but camera maintains distance): After landing and stabilizing, she does not look at S1. Instead, she first looks down at her seized wrist, then raises her eyes, her gaze tracing from S1's hand up to his face—no struggle, no cry, only cold scrutiny in her eyes, as if assessing a case delivered to her door. S1's hand involuntarily loosens under her stare."
]

<d>[Chinese] 张三，我就问问……总卖那些骗人的玩意儿，良心不会痛吗？</d> S1 speaks in a mid-low register with an anxious, slightly breathy tone, speaking faster than normal. He cuts in urgently through the lingering resonance of the gong, trying to grasp S2's arm again—she gently twists and slips free, leaving him lunge into empty air with his hand suspended, forced to chase her retreating figure with his question. His voice cracks on the word "ask." Lip movement is synchronized precisely with the dialogue. The dialogue contains 18 characters, lasts approximately 4.5 seconds, begins at 00:01.2, and must be completed by 00:06.0. During the dialogue, the gongs and drums subside to sparse ban drum hits in the background (indicating Wang-zong's faction yielding). With her back to him, S2 carefully rolls the newly unrolled scroll back onto her body—she asks her question while she performs her task, neither looking at the other. The camera slowly cross-cuts between the two: close-up of Wang-zong (anxiously pressing for an answer) ↔ medium shot of S2 in profile (framed from the upper edge of her thighs to the top of her head). In her movements of lifting her leg to arrange the scroll and bending to smooth it out, her leg lines and waist naturally emerge through the fabric, with the half-opened neckline faintly visible—each time the scroll rolls tighter, the camera retreats a step, maintaining consistent politeness.

台词中段（约00:03.5），插入 <Subject 2> 侧身近景MCU（止于胸部以上）：她卷书的手在听到"骗人的玩意儿"五个字时顿住一瞬——不是被冒犯的停顿，而是像账房先生听见一笔新生意，指尖在卷轴上轻轻一捻，随即若无其事继续卷。无台词，眼神掠过一丝计算的微光：案子来了。板鼓在此停一拍，小锣极轻"台"一声（张三阵营第一次发声），再续上。

台词落定（00:06.0），进入本片第一段"展示镜头序列"（tilt up 纵向摇镜，节奏刻意放慢）：镜头从她赤足起，沿小腿、腿侧线条缓摇而上——她正弯腰把最后一卷卷轴从脚边拾起、直身系好；摇镜经过腰际时稍作停留（衣料收拢、腰身线条一闪），继续上行至衣襟领口——她低头将衣襟掩齐，领口随动作将掩未掩；最终镜头停在她近景MCU（止于胸部以上）：她理好衣襟后抬眸，终于正眼看向王总。这一整段摇镜配小锣轻点"台、台、台"，冷而克制，如旦角定神；她的凌乱在镜头上缓缓收拢为齐整，静止与 S1 的焦虑成对比。右移pan与摇镜均保持180度轴线（轴线西侧）。

Her voice is a tenor, crisp and precise, with clinical coldness; every syllable is placed exactly. At the final character, her jaw tightens almost imperceptibly. The line is 6 characters long, duration approx. 1.5 seconds, must be finished before 00:08.7, and no later than 00:09.0.

The moment the words land, the gongs and drums give him no respite—a "chaos hammer" explodes (cymbals and large gongs intersecting chaotically and disorderly), as if these six words have disrupted his formation. Reaction lasts approx. 1 second, no dialogue. In the fading tail of the chaos hammer, reverse cut to <Subject 2>’s closing reaction (MCU close-up): she watches S1’s pained expression without smugness, only the flatness of "I knew it long ago"—like a hunter seeing prey trigger a trap it laid itself. Cut to <Subject 1> MCU close-up (cut off above the chest): still frozen in the shock of "How are you different from Cao the Traitor?", the chaos hammer slows to a halt, leaving only the single taps of the ban drum "Tap... Tap...", like an abacus clicking through numbers in his mind. Expression shift: shock fades, confusion takes over, eyes narrow. He is thinking. Duration approx. 1.2 seconds, no dialogue.

00:11.2 Power reversal transition: The camera trucks right slowly, moving away from S1, passing over his shoulder to place <Subject 2> steadily in the center of the frame, with S1 retreating to the edge of the frame in soft focus. She is now fully dressed, standing several paces from the bed. This shot gives her a frontal Medium Shot MS (framing from waist up to head, attire complete, posture upright)—her composure becomes the compositional focus; behind her, at the edge of the bed, <Subject 3> sits curled up in blankets, looking at S1 then S2, bewildered—a blurred silhouette, serving as a comedic footnote ignored by all. Music transitions here: the jing hu exits, the sanxian plucking enters—a sharp, folk-style melody following her composure.

00:12.0 <Subject 2> MCU close-up (cut off above the chest): She slowly clasps her hands in front of her—the small cymbal rings 'Ting' at the touch of her fingertips, like a seal being stamped. She raises her eyes to sweep S1, her gaze measuring him from head to toe, like verifying a client’s solvency. A professional gesture, marking the shift from private bedroom matters to business consultation. Expression shift: Coldness yields to clinical focus.

<d>[Chinese] 这叫知识付费！花几万买课，比去赌场划算多了！</d> From 00:12.0: Her voice maintains a tenor range with clinical precision. The dialogue is paired with sanxian and ban-gu "shu ban" (counted verse) in a small allegretto—her sharp-witted rhythm bounces in sync with the lines, brimming with humor; she pauses at "hua suan" (cost-effective)—the sanxian and ban-gu abruptly stop simultaneously, leaving the word suspended in mid-air. Lip-sync is precise. The dialogue is 20 characters long, lasting approximately 5 seconds, finished before 00:17.0. During the dialogue, the camera executes a very slow arc movement centered on her; her MCU (Medium Close-Up) consistently occupies the visual focal point, while S1’s silhouette exists only at the edge of the frame as part of the composition.

In the silence of the bargain (around 00:16.0), cut to <Subject 2> in a Close-Up MCU: she isn't looking at S1, head lowered, her fingertip lightly tapping on the back of her interlaced hands, like a bookkeeper flicking the last abacus bead; then her eyes lift, precisely catching S1's face—she is waiting for him to absorb those words. The hunter's gaze lasts for about 0.8 seconds, no dialogue. Only then does the camera cut to S1: his eyes suddenly widen, pupils constrict, the corners of his mouth lift involuntarily. The banju drum restarts in the depths of his eyes: the roll "Dri-dri-dri" accelerates from slow to fast, continuously building momentum. This is the precursor to an epiphany. Lasts for about 1.5 seconds, no dialogue.

Board drums roll with full intensity; the camera freezes on S1's close-up MCU. He begins to smile—the grin spreading from the corners of his mouth across his entire face. The instant he raises his head to stare directly into the lens and breaks the fourth wall, the gongs and drums strike the "Four-Beat Strike" reveal—clack, crack, clack, crack, clack—! He is pinned into the frame as if nailed by the gong’s echo, frozen for half a beat. Her satisfaction is nearly invisible, yet as she tilts her head, the small gong rings out a sharp "ding" for her, finishing the thought in her place. Shot duration: 00:22.000.

[Shot 3] At 00:22.000, "Client Bites"——Pacing: President Wang's ecstatic main theme, Zhang San's three cold reverse cuts.
